CREATE FUNCTION CDN.KOL_AdresyDoPrzyjecia( @p_ope int, @p_twr int, @p_tpa int, @p_cck int, @p_cecha varchar(20), @p_ean varchar(40), @p_data int, @p_dst int, @p_mag int, @p_ilosc decimal(11,4), @p_jms int, @p_iloscjms int, @p_dlugosc decimal(5,2), @p_szerokosc decimal(5,2), @p_wysokosc decimal(5,2) )
returns @adresy2 table(adres varchar(25),mga_id int, ilosc decimal(15,6))
as begin
if @p_tpa<0 set @p_tpa=0 if @p_data<0 set @p_data=null if @p_dst<0 set @p_dst=null if @p_jms<0 set @p_jms=0
declare @adresy table(adres varchar(25),mga_id int, ilosc decimal(15,6)) if @p_jms = 0 begin insert into @adresy select cdn.pobierzmagadres(MgA_Id) adres, MgA_Id, Ilosc from ( select MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, TPM_Domyslna, Partia, Towar, Odleglosc, case when MPA_Rodzaj=0 then @p_ilosc when Twr_ObjJedn>0 and convert(float,PozObjetosc)*Twr_WagaJedn<convert(float,PozNosnosc)*Twr_ObjJedn then PozObjetosc/Twr_ObjJedn when Twr_WagaJedn>0 then PozNosnosc/Twr_WagaJedn else @p_ilosc end Ilosc from ( select MgO_Kod, Elem.MgA_Id, Elem.MgA_Segment1, Elem.MgA_Segment2, Elem.MgA_Segment3, Elem.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_PriorytetS, MPA_Objetosc-Objetosc PozObjetosc, MPA_Nosnosc-Waga PozNosnosc, MTO_Count, case when isnull(TPM_MgAId,0)=Elem.MgA_Id then 1 else 0 end TPM_Domyslna, Partia, Towar, Twr_ObjetoscL/case Twr_WymJM when 'mm' then 1000000000 when 'cm' then 1000000 when 'dm' then 1000 else 1 end Twr_ObjJedn, Twr_WagaBrutto*case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end Twr_WagaJedn, min(case when Elem.MgO_Id<>Tow.MgO_Id then 10000 else 0 end + 100*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment1)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment1)) + 10*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment2)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment2)) + 5*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment3)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment3)) + case when Elem.Mga_Segment4<>Tow.MgA_Segment4 then 1 else 0 end) Odleglosc from ( select TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, TZM_Towar+count(MaN_GIDNumer) Towar, TZM_Partia+count(case when TPA_Id=@p_tpa then 1 when TPA_CCKNumer=@p_cck and TPA_Cecha=@p_cecha and TPA_Ean=isnull(@p_ean,TPA_Ean) and TPA_DataW=isnull(@p_data,TPA_DataW) and (TPA_DstNumer=isnull(@p_dst,TPA_DstNumer) or Twr_PartiaDostawa=0) then 1 else null end) Partia, TZM_Inne+sum(case when MaN_GIDNumer is not null and isnull(TPA_TwrNumer-TwrNumer,0)<>0 then 1 else 0 end) Inne, TZM_Objetosc+isnull(sum(MaP_Ilosc*Twr_ObjetoscL/case Twr_WymJM when 'mm' then 1000000000 when 'cm' then 1000000 when 'dm' then 1000 else 1 end),0) Objetosc, TZM_Waga+isnull(sum(MaP_Ilosc*Twr_WagaBrutto*case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end),0) Waga from ( select TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, count(TZM_MgAId) TZM_Towar, count(case when TPA_Id=@p_tpa then 1 when TPA_CCKNumer=@p_cck and TPA_Cecha=@p_cecha and TPA_Ean=isnull(@p_ean,TPA_Ean) and TPA_DataW=isnull(@p_data,TPA_DataW) and (TPA_DstNumer=isnull(@p_dst,TPA_DstNumer) or Twr_PartiaDostawa=0) then 1 else null end) TZM_Partia, sum(case when isnull(TPA_TwrNumer-TwrNumer,0)<>0 then 1 else 0 end) TZM_Inne, isnull(sum(TZM_Ilosc*Twr_ObjetoscL/case Twr_WymJM when 'mm' then 1000000000 when 'cm' then 1000000 when 'dm' then 1000 else 1 end),0) TZM_Objetosc, isnull(sum(TZM_Ilosc*Twr_WagaBrutto*case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end),0) TZM_Waga from ( select A.MgA_Id, A.MgA_Segment1, A.MgA_Segment2, A.MgA_Segment3, A.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Wysokosc*MPA_Szerokosc*MPA_Dlugosc MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, Twr_GIDNumer TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, count(MTO_MgOId) MTO_Count from CDN.MagAdresy A inner join CDN.MagParAdr on MPA_Id=MgA_MPAId inner join CDN.MagObszary on MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId inner join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=@p_twr left outer join CDN.MagParJednostki on MPJ_MPAId=MPA_Id --MSm begin --left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_MagNumer=@p_mag and InN_TStampZam=0 left outer join CDN.InwMag on InM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_Id=InM_InNId and InN_TStampZam=0 --MSm end left outer join CDN.InwArk on InA_MgOId=MgO_Id and InA_InNId=InN_Id left outer join CDN.MagAdresy O on O.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdOd left outer join CDN.MagAdresy D on D.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdDo and A.MgA_Segment1+A.MgA_Segment2+A.MgA_Segment3+A.MgA_Segment4 between O.MgA_Segment1+O.MgA_Segment2+O.MgA_Segment3+O.MgA_Segment4 and D.MgA_Segment1+D.MgA_Segment2+D.MgA_Segment3+D.MgA_Segment4 left outer join CDN.TwrLinki on TwL_GIDTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and TwL_GIDNumer=Twr_GIDNumer left outer join CDN.MagTwrObszary on MTO_MgOId=MgO_Id and ((TwL_GROTyp=MTO_TwrTyp and TwL_GRONumer=MTO_TwrNumer) or (MTO_TwrTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and MTO_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer)) where isnull(MPJ_JednostkaLog,MPA_Rodzaj)=0 -- mozna skladowac luzem and MgO_MagNumer=@p_mag -- adres wlasciwego magazynu and D.MgA_Id is null -- adres nie nalezy do zakresu inwentaryzacji group by Twr_GIDNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, A.MgA_Id, A.MgA_Segment1, A.MgA_Segment2, A.MgA_Segment3, A.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Wysokosc, MPA_Szerokosc, MPA_Dlugosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MgO_Towary having MgO_Towary=1 or count(MTO_MgOId)>0 -- mozna skladowac towar w obszarze ) Adr left outer join CDN.TwrZasobyMag on TZM_MgaId=MgA_Id left outer join CDN.TwrPartie on TPA_Id=TZM_TPAId left outer join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TPA_TwrNumer group by TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count ) Zas left outer join CDN.MagPElem on MaP_MgAId=MgA_Id left outer join CDN.MagNag on MaN_GIDNumer=MaP_GIDNumer and MaN_Stan<3 left outer join CDN.MagElem on MaE_GIDNumer=MaN_GIDNumer and MaE_GIDLp=MaP_GIDLp left outer join CDN.TwrPartie on TPA_Id=MaE_TPAId left outer join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TPA_TwrNumer group by TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, TZM_Towar, TZM_Partia, TZM_Inne, TZM_Objetosc, TZM_Waga ) Elem inner join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TwrNumer left outer join CDN.TwrParMag on TPM_TwrTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and TPM_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer and TPM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join ( select MgA_Id, MgO_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4 from ( select TZM_MgAId from CDN.TwrPartie inner join CDN.TwrZasobyMag on TZM_TpaId=TPA_Id and TZM_MgAId>0 where TPA_TwrTyp=16 and TPA_TwrNumer=@p_twr union select MaP_MgAId from CDN.TwrPartie inner join CDN.MagElem on MaE_TpaId=TPA_Id inner join CDN.MagNag on MaN_GIDNumer=MaE_GIDNumer and MaN_Stan<3 inner join CDN.MagPElem on MaP_GIDNumer=MaN_GIDNumer and MaP_GIDLp=MaE_GIDLp where TPA_TwrTyp=16 and TPA_TwrNumer=@p_twr ) Towar inner join CDN.MagAdresy on MgA_Id=TZM_MgAId inner join CDN.MagParAdr on MPA_Id=MgA_MPAId inner join CDN.MagObszary on MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId and MgO_MagNumer=@p_mag -- adres wlasciwego magazynu where MPA_Rodzaj=1 -- nie pole odkladcze ) Tow on 1=1 where MPA_Rodzaj=0 or (MPA_Objetosc-Objetosc>0 and MPA_Nosnosc-Waga>0 and Inne=0) group by Elem.MgO_Id, Elem.MgO_Kod, Elem.MgA_Id, Elem.MgA_Segment1, Elem.MgA_Segment2, Elem.MgA_Segment3, Elem.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_Objetosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, TPM_MgAId, Twr_ObjetoscL, Twr_WymJM, Twr_WagaBrutto, Twr_Wjm, Objetosc, Waga, Partia, Towar ) Odl ) Ilosc where Ilosc>0 order by -TPM_Domyslna, -- czy lokalizacja domyslna -MPA_Rodzaj, -- pola odkladcze na koniec case when Partia>0 then 0 when Towar=0 then 1 else 2 end, -- czy lokalizacja jest pusta case when MTO_Count>0 then 0 else 1 end, -- jest przypisany do obszaru case when @p_ilosc<=Ilosc then 0 else 1 end, -- towar miesci sie w calosci MPA_PriorytetS, -- priorytet skladowania case when @p_ilosc<=Ilosc then Ilosc else -Ilosc end, -- ile towaru mozna zmiescic isnull(Odleglosc,2147483647), -- odleglosc od tego samego towaru MgO_Kod, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4 -- kolejnosc alfabetyczna end else begin insert into @adresy select cdn.pobierzmagadres(MgA_Id) adres, MgA_Id, @p_Ilosc Ilosc from ( select Elem.MgO_Kod, Elem.MgA_Id, Elem.MgA_Segment1, Elem.MgA_Segment2, Elem.MgA_Segment3, Elem.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, case when isnull(TPM_MgAId,0)=Elem.MgA_Id then 1 else 0 end TPM_Domyslna, Partia, Towar, min(case when Elem.MgO_Id<>Tow.MgO_Id then 10000 else 0 end + 100*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment1)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment1)) + 10*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment2)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment2)) + 5*abs(convert(int,Elem.MgA_Segment3)-convert(int,Tow.MgA_Segment3)) + case when Elem.Mga_Segment4<>Tow.MgA_Segment4 then 1 else 0 end) Odleglosc from ( select TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, MTO_Count, TZM_Towar+count(MaN_GIDNumer) Towar, TZM_Partia+count(case when TPA_Id=@p_tpa then 1 when TPA_CCKNumer=@p_cck and TPA_Cecha=@p_cecha and TPA_Ean=isnull(@p_ean,TPA_Ean) and TPA_DataW=isnull(@p_data,TPA_DataW) and (TPA_DstNumer=isnull(@p_dst,TPA_DstNumer) or Twr_PartiaDostawa=0) then 1 else null end) Partia, TZM_Inne+sum(case when MaN_GIDNumer is not null and isnull(MaP_JednostkaLog-@p_jms,0)<>0 then 1 else 0 end) Inne, TZM_IloscJed+isnull(count(MaN_GIDNumer),0) IloscJed, TZM_Waga+isnull(sum(MaP_Ilosc*Twr_WagaBrutto*case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end),0) Waga from ( select TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, MTO_Count, count(TZM_MgAId) TZM_Towar, count(case when Z.TPA_Id=@p_tpa then 1 when TPA_CCKNumer=@p_cck and TPA_Cecha=@p_cecha and TPA_Ean=isnull(@p_ean,TPA_Ean) and TPA_DataW=isnull(@p_data,TPA_DataW) and (TPA_DstNumer=isnull(@p_dst,TPA_DstNumer) or Twr_PartiaDostawa=0) then 1 else null end) TZM_Partia, sum(case when isnull(TZM_JednostkaLog-@p_jms,0)<>0 then 1 else 0 end) TZM_Inne, isnull(count(TZM_MgAId),0) TZM_IloscJed, isnull(sum(TZM_Ilosc*Twr_WagaBrutto*case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end),0) TZM_Waga from ( select MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, A.MgA_Id, A.MgA_Segment1, A.MgA_Segment2, A.MgA_Segment3, A.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, count(MTO_MgOId) MTO_Count, Twr_GIDNumer TwrNumer from CDN.MagAdresy A inner join CDN.MagParAdr on MPA_Id=A.MgA_MPAId left outer join CDN.MagParJednostki on MPJ_MPAId=MPA_Id inner join CDN.MagObszary on MgO_Id=A.MgA_MgOId inner join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=@p_twr --MSm begin --left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_MagNumer=@p_mag and InN_TStampZam=0 left outer join CDN.InwMag on InM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_Id=InM_InNId and InN_TStampZam=0 --MSm end left outer join CDN.InwArk on InA_MgOId=MgO_Id and InA_InNId=InN_Id left outer join CDN.MagAdresy O on O.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdOd left outer join CDN.MagAdresy D on D.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdDo and A.MgA_Segment1+A.MgA_Segment2+A.MgA_Segment3+A.MgA_Segment4 between O.MgA_Segment1+O.MgA_Segment2+O.MgA_Segment3+O.MgA_Segment4 and D.MgA_Segment1+D.MgA_Segment2+D.MgA_Segment3+D.MgA_Segment4 left outer join CDN.TwrLinki on TwL_GIDTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and TwL_GIDNumer=Twr_GIDNumer left outer join CDN.MagTwrObszary on MTO_MgOId=MgO_Id and ((TwL_GROTyp=MTO_TwrTyp and TwL_GRONumer=MTO_TwrNumer) or (MTO_TwrTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and MTO_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer)) where isnull(MPJ_JednostkaLog-@p_jms,MPA_Rodzaj)=0 -- mozna skladowac w okreslonej jednostce and MgO_MagNumer=@p_mag -- adres wlasciwego magazynu and D.MgA_Id is null -- adres nie nalezy do zakresu inwentaryzacji and (MPA_Rodzaj=0 -- pole odkladcze lub nie przekroczone wymiary or (@p_dlugosc<=MPA_Dlugosc and @p_szerokosc<=MPA_Szerokosc and @p_wysokosc<=MPA_Wysokosc)) group by MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, A.MgA_Id, A.MgA_Segment1, A.MgA_Segment2, A.MgA_Segment3, A.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, Twr_GIDNumer, MgO_Towary having MgO_Towary=1 or count(MTO_MgOId)>0 -- mozna skladowac towar w obszarze ) Adr left outer join CDN.TwrZasobyMag on TZM_MgaId=MgA_Id left outer join CDN.TwrPartie Z on Z.TPA_Id=TZM_TPAId left outer join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=Z.TPA_TwrNumer group by TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, MPJ_IloscMaks, MTO_Count ) Zas left outer join CDN.MagPElem on MaP_MgAId=MgA_Id left outer join CDN.MagNag on MaN_GIDNumer=MaP_GIDNumer and MaN_Stan<3 left outer join CDN.MagElem on MaE_GIDNumer=MaN_GIDNumer and MaE_GIDLp=MaP_GIDLp left outer join CDN.TwrPartie on TPA_Id=MaE_TPAId left outer join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TPA_TwrNumer group by TwrNumer, MgO_Id, MgO_Kod, MgA_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_Nosnosc, MPA_PriorytetS, MPJ_IloscMaks, MTO_Count, TZM_Towar, TZM_Inne, TZM_Partia, TZM_IloscJed, TZM_Waga ) Elem inner join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TwrNumer inner join CDN.Slowniki on Slw_Id=@p_jms left outer join CDN.TwrParMag on TPM_TwrTyp=Twr_GIDTyp and TPM_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer and TPM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join ( select MgA_Id, MgO_Id, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4 from ( select TZM_MgAId from CDN.TwrPartie inner join CDN.TwrZasobyMag on TZM_TpaId=TPA_Id and TZM_MgAId>0 where TPA_TwrTyp=16 and TPA_TwrNumer=@p_twr union select MaP_MgAId from CDN.TwrPartie inner join CDN.MagElem on MaE_TpaId=TPA_Id inner join CDN.MagNag on MaN_GIDNumer=MaE_GIDNumer and MaN_Stan<3 inner join CDN.MagPElem on MaP_GIDNumer=MaN_GIDNumer and MaP_GIDLp=MaE_GIDLp where TPA_TwrTyp=16 and TPA_TwrNumer=@p_twr ) Towar inner join CDN.MagAdresy on MgA_Id=TZM_MgAId inner join CDN.MagParAdr on MPA_Id=MgA_MPAId inner join CDN.MagObszary on MgO_Id=MgA_MgOId and MgO_MagNumer=@p_mag -- adres wlasciwego magazynu where MPA_Rodzaj=1 -- nie pole odkladcze ) Tow on 1=1 where MPA_Rodzaj=0 or (MPJ_IloscMaks-IloscJed>0 and MPA_Nosnosc-Waga-Slw_WartoscN4*(IloscJed+1)>=@p_ilosc*Twr_WagaBrutto * case Twr_Wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end and Inne=0) group by Elem.MgO_Id, Elem.MgO_Kod, Elem.MgA_Id, Elem.MgA_Segment1, Elem.MgA_Segment2, Elem.MgA_Segment3, Elem.MgA_Segment4, MPA_Rodzaj, MPA_PriorytetS, MTO_Count, TPM_MgAId, Partia, Towar ) Odl order by -TPM_Domyslna, -- czy lokalizacja domyslna -MPA_Rodzaj, -- pola odkladcze na koniec case when Partia>0 then 0 when Towar=0 then 1 else 2 end, -- czy lokalizacja jest pusta case when MTO_Count>0 then 0 else 1 end, -- jest przypisany do obszaru MPA_PriorytetS, -- priorytet skladowania isnull(Odleglosc,2147483647), -- odleglosc od tego samego towaru MgO_Kod, MgA_Segment1, MgA_Segment2, MgA_Segment3, MgA_Segment4 -- kolejnosc alfabetyczna end
insert into @adresy (adres,mga_id,ilosc) values ('Nieznane',0,999999999)
insert into @adresy2 select * from @adresy where ilosc>=@p_ilosc
return
end
